rate_utd_dtap.long_description: Share of assessed school students reported as up to date for diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP/Tdap) vaccination in the state's annual school immunization survey. rate_utd_dtap.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were up to date for DTaP/Tdap vaccination.

rate_medical.long_name: Proportion of students with a medical vaccination exemption
rate_medical.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a medical exemption from one or more required vaccines.
rate_medical.long_description: Share of assessed school students with a physician-certified medical exemption from one or more required vaccines, as reported in the state's annual school immunization survey.
rate_medical.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a medical vaccination exemption.

rate_non_medical.long_name: Proportion of students with a non-medical (personal-belief) vaccination exemption
rate_non_medical.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a non-medical exemption (religious, philosophical, or personal-belief) from vaccination requirements.
rate_non_medical.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding a non-medical exemption from one or more required vaccines. The exemption categories permitted differ by state law - some allow religious exemptions only, others also allow philosophical or personal-belief exemptions - and this harmonized field aggregates whichever non-medical categories the state reports.
rate_non_medical.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a non-medical vaccination exemption.

rate_total.long_name: Proportion of students with any vaccination exemption
rate_total.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with any exemption (medical or non-medical) from vaccination requirements.
rate_total.long_description: Share of assessed school students with at least one vaccination exemption of any type, combining medical and non-medical exemptions. Where a state reports the categories separately this is their sum; overlap handling depends on what the source publishes.
rate_total.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a vaccination exemption of any kind.
